title: Safe Approximate Nonlinear Model Predictive Control Without Expert Demonstrations
abstract: arXiv:2603.24503v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Repeated online optimization makes nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) computationally demanding for real-time applications. Neural approximations reduce this cost but often require large datasets of expert NMPC solutions. We introduce Sequential Approximate MPC (Seq-AMPC), a label-free recurrent framework that generates complete control sequences along predicted trajectories using parameters shared across the prediction horizon. The policy is trained directly through known dynamics with losses for control cost, constraint satisfaction, and a cost-decrease condition aligned with a feasible-backup safety filter. Building on this filter, we introduce a stage-cost-dependent acceptance tolerance that preserves recursive feasibility, constraint satisfaction, and asymptotic convergence under nominal MPC assumptions, independently of neural approximation error. translated_title: 无需专家示范的安全近似非线性模型预测控制
translated_abstract: 在线重复优化使得非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）在实时应用中计算开销巨大。神经网络近似虽能降低该成本，但通常需要大量专家NMPC解构成的数据集。我们提出序列近似MPC（Seq-AMPC），这是一种无需标签的循环框架，利用在整个预测时域内共享的参数，沿着预测轨迹生成完整的控制序列。该策略直接基于已知动力学进行训练，其损失函数涵盖控制代价、约束满足，以及与可行备份安全滤波器相一致的成本下降条件。在该安全滤波器的基础上，我们进一步引入了一种依赖于阶段成本的接受容差，在标称MPC假设下保持递归可行性、约束满足和渐近收敛性，且不受神经网络近似误差的影响。此外，我们还推导了基于Hoeffding不等式的有限样本界，用于期望的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出无需专家示范数据的Seq-AMPC无标签循环框架，通过安全滤波器与接受容差设计，在保证递归可行性与收敛性的同时实现安全的非线性模型预测控制神经近似。
en_tdlr: Seq-AMPC is a label-free recurrent neural approximation of nonlinear MPC that achieves safety, recursive feasibility, and convergence guarantees without requiring expert demonstration data.
